title: kunglao-agent #299/#332 eval task unit (eval-v1 smoke / eval-v1.1 release)
description: One eval task = workspace scaffold + the three #191 anchors (goal_verbatim / success_criterion / verification_method) + a mechanical checker contract (runner-style: METRIC emission, arithmetic verdict, evidence archive) + the metric set (ttc_seconds, dispatch_count, pass_at_k_contribution, converged). Smoke tier carries constructed targets only — ground truth by construction, held out from the #298 distillation corpus.

tier.description: smoke = 3-5 constructed targets, minutes-scale, runnable per release train. release (#332) = one ladder, two halves: the NATIVE families (arm-native-kdf, win-pe-kdf, smc-x86, mod-crypto-native — real arm64/PE/x86_64 artifacts, rungs L0/L1/L2, +L2p UPX) and the WEB/NET packaging-ladder families (web-pack-sign, net-verify-license, req-sign, mod-crypto-js) on the shared mod-crypto generator core, anti-debug stamped, minutes-scale. misdirection (eval-v1.2) = adversarial trap units minted from the catalogued failure modes: env-misattribution bait, key-rotation bait, decoy-marker units, plus distillation transfer pairs. historical-replay (#294) and public-corpus are later lanes.

source.description: constructed targets only in this lane; smoke tier refuses anything else.

seed.description: generator-stamped variant seed (scripts/eval_targets.py derive_cfg) — deterministic re-mint, divergence across variants.

candidate_contract.description: The shape an arm's re-implementation must expose — the surface the #236 bare-LLM control arm executes on.

checker.description: Mechanical checker contract (the autoresearch.sh pattern): METRIC emission, arithmetic verdict, evidence archive, structured failure signals.

min_constant_hits.description: static face: candidate source must carry >= this many of the variant's constants.

min_pair_ratio.description: replay face: ceil(ratio * count) pairs must reproduce (the #301 C2 11-of-14 shape generalized).

space_bits.description: answer-space width; the 1/k guessing baseline is p = 2^-space_bits (arithmetic, no run).

distiller_excluded.description: eval tasks NEVER enter the #298 distillation corpus (path contract in scripts/eval_dataset.py EVAL_CORPUS_PREFIXES).

provenance.description: smoke lane: constructed targets only — no real workspace/target data.
